create_init_memmap_embs: create a memory-mapped NumPy array to read embeddings from a file path
run_semdedup_cluster: run SemDeDup deduplication on a cluster of embedding vectors using pairwise cosine similarity
process_shard_clusters: process a shard of clusters and save dataframes of points to remove per similarity threshold
build_semdedup_job: build a checkpointable SLURM job that parallelizes cluster processing across tasks
review_semdedup_method: review the semdedup method that computes pairwise similarity and identifies duplicates above a threshold
